en.name: Microwave popcorn packets
en.summary: Unopened microwave popcorn packets keep 6–12 months from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard. The 1–2 day figure is for the popped product, not the packet: once you have made a bowl, it is only good for a day or two.
en.pantry: 6–12 months from purchase, stored flat, cool, dry and dark. A microwave packet is not just corn — it holds a solid block of fat and flavouring, and that fat is what sets the shelf life rather than the kernels, which would happily last years on their own. Heat is the thing to avoid: a box stored above the cooker or beside the rice cooker ages the fat and can leave you with a stale, waxy taste long before the printed date. Once popped, the corn is a different food, good for about 1–2 days in a sealed tub.
en.fridge: The cupboard, not the fridge, is the right place for the packets. Refrigerating popped corn is worse still: the fridge is humid and popcorn absorbs moisture faster than almost anything else, so a bowl put in there comes out limp. Keep leftovers in a sealed tub at room temperature and eat them within a day or two.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published. There is no reason to freeze unpopped packets — the cupboard figure already runs most of a year — and freezing popped corn only guarantees condensation on the way out, which softens it. If you have more popped corn than you can eat, a sealed tub at room temperature is the only sensible option.
en.thawing: Not applicable. Microwave popcorn is a cupboard item, and the popped corn should not be frozen.
spoilage: A stale, waxy or rancid smell when you open the packet — the fat has turned.
A packet that has been stored warm and smells of old oil before popping.
Popped corn that has gone chewy and leathery, which is moisture rather than spoilage.
Scorched, bitter corn from over-popping, which cannot be rescued.
tips: Store the box flat and away from the cooker; heat ages the fat inside.
Stop the microwave when the popping slows to a few seconds between pops.
Tip leftovers into a sealed tub rather than leaving them in the bag.
Check the printed date on the outer box before buying a multipack on offer.

faq.q: How long do microwave popcorn packets keep?
faq.a: 6–12 months from purchase, unopened, in a cool and dry cupboard. Once popped, the corn keeps about 1–2 days in a sealed tub.

faq.q: Can you eat microwave popcorn after the date on the box?
faq.a: It is a quality date, not a safety one, and what fades first is the fat, which starts to taste waxy or stale. Smell the packet before popping it.

faq.q: Should leftover popcorn go in the fridge?
faq.a: No. The fridge is humid and popcorn absorbs moisture, so it goes limp. Keep it in a sealed tub at room temperature and finish it quickly.

zh.name: 微波爆米花包
zh.summary: 未開封的微波爆米花包自購買日起，放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃可放 6～12 個月。那個 1～2 天是給「爆好之後」的成品，不是給包裝的：爆成一大碗之後，就只剩一兩天。
zh.pantry: 自購買日起 6～12 個月，平放在陰涼、乾燥、避光處。微波包裡不只有玉米，還壓著一塊固態油脂與調味料，而決定保存期限的是那塊油，不是玉米粒——玉米粒自己放好幾年都沒問題。要避開的是熱：放在爐灶上方或電鍋旁的那一盒，油脂老化得快，可能在標示日期之前就出現走味的蠟感。爆開之後它就是另一種食物了，密封盒裝大約 1～2 天。
zh.fridge: 微波包該待的地方是櫥櫃，不是冰箱。把爆好的玉米花冰起來更糟：冰箱潮濕，爆米花吸濕的速度幾乎是全廚房第一，放進去再拿出來就軟了。吃剩的請用密封盒放常溫，並在一兩天內吃完。
zh.freezer: 沒有冷凍的期限數據。未爆的微波包沒有冷凍的理由——櫥櫃本來就給了大半年；而冷凍爆好的玉米花只會保證拿出來時結露、變軟。爆太多吃不完的話，密封盒放常溫是唯一合理的做法。
zh.thawing: 不適用。微波爆米花是櫥櫃食品，爆好的成品也不該冷凍。
spoilage: 拆封時聞到陳味、蠟味或油耗味——油脂已經走味。
存放在高溫處的包裝，還沒爆就有久放的油味。
爆好的玉米花變得韌韌像皮革，那是受潮不是腐敗。
爆過頭燒焦發苦，這救不回來。
tips: 整盒平放、遠離爐灶；熱會加速裡面油脂老化。
爆裂聲間隔拉長到幾秒一聲時就停掉微波爐。
吃剩的倒進密封盒，不要留在原本的紙袋裡。
特價買整箱前，先看外盒的標示日期。

faq.q: 微波爆米花包可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 6～12 個月，放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃。爆好之後密封盒裝大約 1～2 天。

faq.q: 過了盒上日期還能吃嗎？
faq.a: 那是品質日期不是安全日期，最先退場的是油脂，會開始有蠟感或陳味。微波前先聞一下包裝。

faq.q: 吃剩的爆米花要冰冰箱嗎？
faq.a: 不要。冰箱潮濕，爆米花會吸濕變軟。密封盒放常溫，並盡快吃完。
